one_month_reasoning: Lattice's own Q3 2026 report is expected Nov 3, 2026 after the close (source 14), so it falls just outside the window ending 2026-11-01 (a Sunday, so the last close is Oct 30). Inside the window: (1) about Oct 25, 2026 the first 25% tranche of the ~5.2M shares issued to THL/AMI holders comes free of transfer restrictions (90 days after the Jul 27 close), and THL has two underwritten block trades (source 3). That is about 1.3M shares (<1% of 142M outstanding), small but a mild overhang, and a block trade usually comes at a 3-5% discount. (2) Late-October hyperscaler capex prints and AI-semi peer earnings drive this AI-levered name. The Sept SK Hynix HBM scare showed how sector moves dominate (source 11). (3) The stock rebounded from about $106 (mid-Sep insider sale prices, source 5) to $134, including +4% on Oct 2, so short-term momentum and pre-earnings run-up offset the lockup supply. Net: close to a symmetric lognormal at monthly vol 61%/3.5 = 17.4%, with the median shaded slightly to about $133 for the lockup/block-trade overhang.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (CY2028E non-GAAP EPS $3.40 x 38 = $129, 60%) and EV/EBITDA (CY2027E adj. EBITDA $510M x 35 less ~$430M projected net debt over ~146M shares = $120, 40%), giving about $125 as the Oct-2027 fair value. Both are skeptic-leaning multiples for a ~25% grower carrying new acquisition debt.

bear.story: AI-server/data-center demand digests in 2027 and channel inventory builds again (95% of sales go through distributors, so visibility is poor; the 2024-25 inventory correction cut revenue ~30%). FPGA growth stalls, the AMI integration disappoints, $925M of secured debt limits flexibility, and THL block trades add supply. EPS ~$2.20 on a 30-33x multiple gives ~$70-75.

base.story: Revenue reaches ~$1.26B in 2027 with EPS ~ $2.8 and 2028E ~ $3.4. The multiple compresses from ~55-69x NTM to ~40x as growth normalises, so earnings growth roughly offsets de-rating and the stock ends near today's level.

bull.story: The companion-chip/AI server attach rate and AMI cross-sell keep FPGA growth at 40%+. 2028E EPS of $4.5+ holds a ~45-48x premium multiple, in line with the top sell-side targets ($180) and beyond.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$92 (about -31% and well under the mid-September ~$106 macro-driven low) the market would be pricing roughly 30x EPS of only ~$3, which is consistent with FPGA growth stalling or a renewed channel-inventory correction rather than ordinary sector volatility. At that point the bull case (sustained AI attach plus AMI) is likely broken. A breach also coincides with leverage rising toward ~2x+ net debt/EBITDA under covenanted net-leverage and interest-coverage tests.

reasoning: The skeptic's search found no short-seller report, fraud allegation, material litigation or accounting red flag. GAAP-to-non-GAAP gaps are mostly SBC and acquisition charges, and Q2 FCF of $81M (40% margin) backs the earnings. Insider selling is real but small and routine: Form 4s from May-Sep 2026 show about 50k shares sold by SVPs/directors (mostly 10b5-1 style plus tax withholding), with no open-market sales by the CEO or CFO. The real bear case is valuation plus cyclicality plus leverage. At $134 the stock is ~$19B market cap and ~$19.9B EV, about 15x 2027E sales and roughly 47x my 2027E EPS. It was a $60 stock 12 months ago, and BofA's long-standing Sell case (premium multiple, channel-inventory risk, competition from AMD/Intel-Altera) is unrefuted in kind, though now stale. The AMI deal adds $925M of secured debt at SOFR+1-1.75% with leverage and coverage covenants, 5.2M shares of dilution with staged lockup releases, and integration risk. Against that, fundamentals are strong: revenue +62% YoY, guided FPGA +65% for Q3, EPS beat by ~19%, and sell-side targets average $164-168 (range $125-180). My fair value of ~$125 (P/E 38x on 2028E $3.40 and EV/EBITDA 35x) is just under spot, which implies that earnings growth mostly offsets multiple compression. I build the ladder as a mixture: 78% lognormal centred at $145 with sigma 0.45 (base and bull, with ordinary vol below the 61% realised because some of that came from the 2025 trough rebound), plus 22% bear lognormal at $75 with sigma 0.35 (a 2024-style inventory correction or AI digestion). That gives a mean ~ $143, a median ~ $126, P(>=134) ~ 0.455 and a fat left tail (P<94 ~ 29%). Research was limited: consensus EPS estimates and full sell-side notes were not reachable (Twelve Data estimates are paywalled), so EPS paths are my own builds from guidance.
